episodes.synopsis: Sei greets her second summer in this world. Now that the miasma is under control and she has a bit of free time to do a little exploring...
episodes.title: The Trading Company

episodes.synopsis: After discovering coffee, Sei decides to go to Morgenhaffen, a port city in Salutania, in her search for items or ingredients from Japan.
episodes.title: A Foreign Country

episodes.synopsis: Sei is invited to the royal palace for the Holy Saint's official debut. On top of that, it seems like she must also attend the royal ball.
episodes.title: The Ceremony

episodes.synopsis: The royal palace summons Sei once again. It seems they are getting a foreign exchange student, an imperial prince from Zaidera...
episodes.title: The Imperial Prince

episodes.synopsis: Sei remains wary around the imperial prince, but after learning a bit more of his situation, she grows curious about what he's really doing in the country.
episodes.title: Purpose

episodes.synopsis: Now that Sei knows Prince Ten'yuu needs her help, she tries to think of a way to create a panacea without exposing her powers as the Holy Saint.
episodes.title: Divine Blessing

episodes.synopsis: Now that things have settled down, a new problem is arising. It seems that everyone is trying to get the Holy Saint to marry into their family...
episodes.title: Interlude

episodes.synopsis: Sei goes to the farthest end of the kingdom, the Hawke Region, for what the royal palace believes to be her final expedition as the Holy Saint.
episodes.title: Frontier

episodes.synopsis: To combat the source of the miasma and the unusual monsters in the area, Sei and her faithful guard venture into the local mine, where a frightful danger awaits them...
episodes.title: Final Act

episodes.synopsis: It seems that Sei's duties as a Holy Saint are coming to an end with the purification of the last miasma swamp. Now Sei must start thinking about her future.
episodes.title: Longing

episodes.synopsis: Rumors are swirling about Sei and her theater date, which has her feeling self-conscious with everyone. Can she acknowledge her own...
episodes.title: Blessing
